title: Ritwik Ghatak's birth chart
metaDescription: Ritwik Ghatak's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.3° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Mars and Neptune sit 0.8° from an exact sextile — near enough that the tradition reads drive and imagination as a single working part. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 11.3° Scorpio. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a water sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 27.8° Scorpio, Venus at 27.0° Sagittarius, Mars at 23.8° Libra. Mercury in a water sign reads as a mind that absorbs before it argues; Venus in a fire sign reads as taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; Mars in an air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mars to Neptune is the closest call of the day, a sextile within 0.8°. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Jupiter sextile Saturn at 1.0°, and Saturn trine Pluto at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon opposes Venus while both square Uranus. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mars in Libra at 23.8° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Capricorn at 17.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 water, 2 air, 2 fire, 1 earth by element and 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal by mode. Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Gemini for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.4° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 23.4°.
